decisions.reason: Only a brief website mention suggests limited public commitment, but the product is close to the established offer and early results can still be attributed to temporary causes, so the firm will not yet write off the investment.
The website reports a positive market share result, so there is no disappointment to explain and the firm will keep this visibly successful product.
Having its own webpage indicates visible public commitment and sunk costs, and with no reported negative results after one year the firm will continue the product.
